text:
ravi: quick sync - we need an unambiguous play for SI co-sell + marketplace orders. last week9s handoff with Northpoint leaked into 3 teams. want to reduce churn.

sophia: +1. can we set a deterministic routing priority? thinking: 1) explicit SI evidence (SOW/invoice/customer cc) -> SI, 2) marketplace listing with partner_id -> SI, 3) Redwood-originated inbound -> Redwood, 4) simultaneous engagement -> joint.

kevin: add nuance for paid pilots: if SI is underwriting the pilot (PO/SOW) they get precedence even if RW originated. put an expiration on claims (e.g., claims must be asserted within 10 days of lead).

margo: ops note: marketplace checkout often strips partner metadata. propose heuristic: if sku startswith("partner_") OR order_meta contains partner_account -> auto-assign to SI, else leave unassigned and surface to ops. filing OPS-9001.

ops-bot: Created OPS-9001: "marketplace partner attribution heuristic" assigned to margo, due 2024-07-18.

sophia: can we standardize SFDC intake fields so claim decisions are automated? suggested fields: origin, claim_evidence_url, claim_type, claim_window_days, primary_owner_id. small snippet below.

ravi: yes, include claim evidence types: sow, invoice, customer_email, portal_action. also require at least one evidence URL for SI_claim.

kevin: disagreement corner: what about channel conflict with resellers/DSRs? suggest escalation path: if reseller chain present -> escalate to partnerships for manual mapping. maybe add a required reseller_chain field in intake.

sophia: good call. Also we need a 3-business-day SLA for disputes: if unresolved, lock assignment to earliest documented outreach and notify both parties + buyer. operations should also produce a short clear email template.

margo: jotting down handoff checklist to avoid ping-pong: 1) 1-paragraph summary, 2) named POC for SI and RW, 3) POC for procurement, 4) next two actions with owners. Publish as checklist in partner portal.

kevin: propose a short JSON snippet for SFDC JSON mapping we can paste into intake automation: 
```
"claim_origin": "[redwood|si|marketplace]",
"claim_evidence_type": "[sow|invoice|email|portal]",
"claim_evidence_url": "string",
"claim_window_days": "10",
"primary_owner": "[redwood|si|joint]",
"escalation_contact": "partnerships@redwood.com"
```

sophia: love it. can someone own the one-pager + intake change? target publish by Friday so sales/SEs use it next week.

ravi: I can draft the one-pager and the short email templates for claim assign/lock.

margo: I9ll file OPS-9001 details and add SFDC field wiring with kevin.

kevin: will update the intake validation rules and add UI copy for joint claims.

sophia: legal check: can we have locking SLA language? tagging legal separately, but we should draft conservative wording.

ops-bot: Note: please attach any anonymized customer examples to the playbook doc so we can include FAQ.

ravi: will add an anonymized ACME example.

sophia: final ask: include a short flow graphic in the one-pager (3 boxes: Assert Claim -> Validate Evidence -> Assign/Lock -> Notify). makes it clear to SEs.

margo: ack. posting progress back here as pieces land. this should cut down on duplicate outreach and delays. :thumbsup:
